meta.title: For streamers — overlays, challenges and chat commands
meta.description: Live-stat OBS overlays, donation challenges verified from real battles, !stat and !session chat commands and your own streamer page.

hero.title: A stream where <hot>the numbers don't lie</hot>
hero.lead: Live stats in OBS, viewer challenges verified from the actual battle, and a bot that knows your WN8 better than chat does.

tools.title: Everything you need on air
tools.description: Four tools that work together: data from the mod and the API flows straight into your overlay, chat and page.

overlays.title: OBS overlays
overlays.text: Session, WN8, gun mark, win streak — pick the metrics and a style, paste the link into OBS. Transparent background, live numbers.

challenges.title: Verified challenges
challenges.text: A viewer donates with a code and a condition — “3000 damage in a light tank”. The mod checks the real battle, not the streamer's word. The result goes to chat and the overlay by itself.

commands.title: Chat commands
commands.text: Twitch and VK Video Live: the bot answers with stats while you're in battle.

page.title: Streamer page
page.text: A short address with channel links, live status and battle stats — handy for your channel description.

flow.title: Donation → battle → verdict
flow.description: No arguing in chat: the condition is fixed up front and the mod checks the result from battle data.

donate.title: A viewer donates with a code
donate.text: You create a challenge in the studio; the viewer puts its code in the donation message.
donate.sample: #K7Q2M 3000 dmg in a light, let's go!

verify.title: The mod checks the battle
verify.text: Bronevik takes your battle results from the mod: damage, frags, spotting — no screenshots, no word of honour.

result.title: The verdict hits chat and the overlay
result.text: The bot posts the verdict in chat, the overlay shows progress and the result. Fully transparent for viewers.

cta.title: Go live with Bronevik
cta.text: Link your account with Lesta ID and your first overlay is ready in a couple of minutes.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Donations flow into Bronevik and the bot answers in chat. You connect through the service's own sign-in — we never see passwords.

about.twitch: The bot answers !stat, !session and !marks and posts challenge results to chat.
about.vkPlayLive: Chat commands and challenge results for VK Video Live.
